title: Restarting a hill climber
description: You can compare a first-improvement definition with the restart routine used by the driver.

steps.description: first_choice_hc accepts the first improving neighbor and breaks out of its inner loop. The loop's else returns the current state when no improvement is found.
random_restart_hc generates a starting state and calls hill_climb for each restart. You keep the highest-scoring solution seen so far.

steps.question: Does the demonstration invoke first_choice_hc?
steps.answer: No. It invokes random_restart_hc, which calls the earlier hill_climb function.

steps.description: You request 25 restarts from random integers between -50 and 50. The supplied output reports RR-HC best: 7 value: 50.0.
